about.what: Odds that the lowest PSA10 ask reaches a price within 30 / 90 days.
about.method: Zero-drift model on the card's own volatility. sigma = card's recent 30/90-day log-return spread (last 8 two-week observations of pokeca-chart PSA10 prices), shrunk toward the pool's last-6-months spread (weight n/(n+6)), then multiplied by the market-volatility factor: (RMS of the market's 30-day moves over the last 90 days / RMS over all earlier history) ^ 0.25, market move = average 30-day return of all cards in the same two-week bucket (market_vol.factor is the value at build time). z = ln(target / lowest ask) / sigma. 90 days: P = share of historical z_touch90 at or below z (the lowest price seen in the next 90 days, monthly-sampled). 30 days: P = 1.29 x share of historical z_end30 at or below z (the price 30 days later; 1.29 = touch/endpoint ratio measured on 90-day windows). Capped at 99%.
about.backtest: Rolling out-of-sample test 2024-01 to 2026-08 on 125 modern PSA10 cards (15,695 30-day and 13,485 90-day threshold events). Brier score, lower is better. 30 days: this model 0.089, pool volatility only 0.090, adding momentum/market trend 0.091, historical base rate 0.105. 90 days: this model 0.121, pool volatility only 0.124, base rate 0.172, adding momentum/market trend 0.178. Trend and momentum made forecasts worse, so none is used.
about.limits: pokeca-chart history is monthly before Aug 2026, so dips inside a month are only estimated. Single cheap listings on SNKRDUNK can dip below the smoothed price and are not modelled. Cards without pokeca-chart history use the pool volatility.
about.backtest_market_vol_2026_10_02: Replicated rolling backtest 2024-01 to 2026-08 (z-curves rebuilt each month from earlier data only; 15,570 30-day and 13,920 90-day events). Brier without / with the market factor (power 0.25, 90-day window): 30 days 0.0925 / 0.0900, 90 days 0.1495 / 0.1422. Better in 2024, the 2025 boom and the 2025-26 peak and crash alike. 95% CI of the gain by resampling months: 30 days -0.005 to +0.000, 90 days -0.014 to -0.000. Power 0.5 gained more in the crash but was worse in 2024; a 60-day window was worse, 180 days similar. Demeaning vs RMS spread and a 90-day pool window did not help. (The replica's absolute Brier is higher than the original 0.089 / 0.121 because it rebuilds the z-curves monthly; compare within the replica.)

source: pokeca-chart PSA10 price history, 125 modern cards
